voice_lines.intro: A glass booth squeals along its ceiling rail and stops in front of you. The wooden fortune-teller inside clacks its jaw and introduces itself
voice_lines.twist: Under the graffiti, the wall directory still mostly reads. Somebody lettered GREEN ROOM, STAFF ONLY far too neatly for it to be a joke.
voice_lines.win: The shutter screams up into the ceiling. Proctor Bell rings once, which is either applause or a warning. Beyond the shutter, something skitters.
